Definition
[energy functional]

Source: petersen:page-0199 ↗ def:pet-ch5-curve-length

The arclength functional is $L(c)=\int _0^1|\dot c|\, dt$, $c\in \Omega _{p,q}$; its minima (if they exist) have minimal length but not necessarily the correct (constant-speed) parametrization, and $L$ is invariant under reparametrization. The energy functional \[ E(c)=\frac12\int _0^1|\dot c|^2\, dt,\qquad c\in \Omega _{p,q}, \] depends on parametrization and measures kinetic energy.
